d:
Jharkhand men mausam ka mijaj badalne vala hai. chakravati tuphan 'akvan' ko lekar mausam vibhag (IMD) ne chetavni jari ki hai. rajy ke kaee ilakon men mausam men badlav, barish aur tej havaon ki sanbhavna ko lekar alart jari kiya gaya hai. aakhir jharkhand men tuphan ka kitna asar dekhne ko milega aur kin jilon men mausam badal sakta hai? janie is Weather Update men.
